contract: Bounded checkpoint-before-send intent owner over the existing Store with Cure rearm/history policy: three recorded grounds, narrow provider replay, monotone history, per-attempt settlement/contradiction evidence, and read-only recovery until a nonce/snapshot-bound trusted host activation.
limits: No exactly-once, provider authenticity, physical-send cancellation/fencing, general scheduler, payment integration or distributed lock claim.
Only the validated Elixir owner is supported; step-label laws and a stated reachable-trace argument do not mechanize trace induction or prove Elixir/storage/transport behavior.
Every restart requires trusted reconciliation; no clean-release path, hot binding configuration, business drain or automatic polling/retry.

256-byte identity fields,64KiB arguments,256 attempts/revisions,1024 evidence records up to512B,4096 intent events,128KiB append payload,1MiB each checkpoint; bounded priority retention replaces unbounded retention.
No pruning: up to4GiB encoded intent checkpoints by the hard caps, plus append/SQL/index/replication and separate host activation-log overhead; host retains refusal/intent and activation markers.
Native arithmetic/ETF and provider no-send, final no-effect, replay, identity/clock/storage contracts are external Needs; Memory is explicitly volatile.
Bare Cure State/Config/Decision and dependency record tags require coordinated renaming for redistributed libraries; application copies own one revision.

grounding.claim: Actual step dispatch action occurs only on an allowed Arm from Intended; well-typed Cure inputs.
Definite phase records exactly one declared ground through its named step cases.
Dispatched provenance comes from Intended on Arm or an existing dispatched state.
Fresh intended provenance originates only at Empty admission and is otherwise preserved only by non-dispatch steps.
After(ground) intended provenance originates only from Definite(ground) rearm.
Step never recreates Empty from a nonempty phase.
Attempt count changes only on allowed Arm and increases by one.
Replay dependence is carried monotonically, including rearm from replay-safe ground.
Possibly-sent history flag is carried monotonically and set on dispatch.
Contradiction and uncertainty set quarantine, which subsequent steps preserve.
Revision count changes only on permitted Revise; history is preserved.
Pinned Cure checks production ADTs, decision and completion-history helpers and selected lemmas; audited without axioms, holes, opacity, unresolved, unaudited, non-total or absurd terms.

Owner Memory scenarios: intended/dispatched barriers, unknown timeout/task death, recovery activation, grant binding, replay horizon laundering, schema/revision, eight result pairs, completion races, delayed old send, physical resend negative and refused send-sourced poll evidence.
Production audit, real silent-return/groundless/history proof mutations, positive and horizon controls, finite guard/history/deadline/revision and malformed-state scenarios.
Actual codec/fold roundtrip, maximal-field layout/reservations, optional saturation and priority writes, limits plus one, canonical decoding and exhaustive build-time binding refusal scenarios.

Own disposable PostgreSQL database: real append/checkpoint barriers, read-only recovery and replay, indeterminate checkpoint, contradictory late evidence and competing fresh-host CAS; consumer owns durability settings.
Byte-identical source closure runs original and renamed modules/record tags in a separate VM using only upstream artifacts, without catalogue Application.
Pinned compiler/conversion/audit, native Int comparisons/arithmetic and erased ADT/record runtime semantics; no compiler soundness claim.
GenServer serialization and Task.Supervisor execution/monitor lifecycle, maps and binary validation.
OTP29.1.2 deterministic ETF safe decoding and crypto SHA-256; no local serialization or cryptographic soundness proof.

Host authenticates observations/reconciliation, stable canonical identity/arguments and clock; controls/fences live owners and uncertain writes; provider honors declared replay/no-effect/no-send contracts; Store durability and retention are external Needs.

telemetry.contract: OTP process/task diagnostics only; no custom exporter or payload telemetry, consumer redacts Adapter exceptions and context; status is inspection not a durable receipt.

config.contract: Build-time binding and startup Store/host/identity/time/deadline configuration with explicitly allowed schema/argument revision; no hot binding reconfiguration.

control.contract: Trusted-host activated synchronous dispatch/rearm/poll/expire/observe/revise; read-only recovery, explicit unknown writes, no drain or physical-send cancellation.
